name: SOAFEE, Inc.
summary: SOAFEE, Inc. provides artificial intelligence (AI) and information technology (IT) services, and enterprise AI software-as a-service (SaaS) solutions for enterprises. It offers AI driven data as a service system (DaaS); SOAFEE healthcare marketplace; applied AI IT services for the health care/life sciences sector; and applied AI SaaS solutions for optimizing business operations. The company was formerly known as Carepay, Inc. and changed its name to SOAFEE, Inc. in February 2022. SOAFEE, Inc. is based in Atlanta, Georgia.
